openQuestions.summary: RESOLVED 2026-08-31. The app's RRSP group reads $38,339.64 against this project's then-$52,634.47. The difference was the spousal RRSP: the owner is the contributor but the asset is the spouse's, so the app counts it under her name. This project now does the same.
openQuestions.leads: This project's RRSP group is $36,816.20 at 2026-07 with the spousal account excluded, against the app's $38,339.64 a month later: +$1,523.44, or +4.1% over August, which market movement covers. The spousal account is still visible and still counted toward the owner's contribution ROOM, which is his. Confirmed by the 2026-06 ground-truth decomposition below, which lands on a residual of exactly $0.00.

openQuestions.summary: RESOLVED 2026-09-26. Against the 2026-08 statements the visible groups ($250,543.54) and this project's total ($250,450.58) differ by $92.96. The earlier $145.44 was a comparison across two dates, the app in late August against statements for July. The seven visible groups are the whole portfolio: the spousal RRSP is not among them and not in either total.
openQuestions.leads: $15,818.27 of that is the spousal RRSP at 2026-07, leaving $145.44 unaccounted -- so the app screen these groups were read from appears to still be counting the spousal asset somewhere, even though its RRSP group is not. Either a group was cut off between the two screenshots, or the screen totals a household rather than an individual. Resolve by noting exactly which accounts the screen counts before taking the next reading.

openQuestions.leads: This project's account lens is the closer match for a per-account comparison.

groundTruthDecomposition.note: Not from this checkpoint, but the finding that resolved it. The owner's 2026-06-30 app reading of $242,019.61 exceeds this project's spousal-excluded 2026-06 total of $227,433.46 by $14,586.15, which decomposes exactly: $14,306.21 spousal RRSP plus $279.94 WSE401 pending valuation, residual $0.00. That the residual is zero to the cent is what makes both explanations testable rather than merely plausible -- and it confirms the 2026-06 app reading DID include the spousal asset.

No parsing defect: the statements price several ETFs a few cents off the 2026-08-31 closing trade (HXQ $117.33 vs close $117.54, VFV $189.04 vs $189.16, QQC $48.51 vs $48.55), while the app values at the close. Checked holding by holding against the day's closes.
